potentialRecoveryCaveat: Not explicitly faulted is not proof of readability: early failure can prevent checking later inputs. Chain Make failure identifies no offending Pico unless explicitly logged.

separatelyPending.scope: snapshot omission, not a claim about the current scheduler state

successfulMeasuredStatistics.scope: actual completion-log counts for frozen successful ROOT sources only

measuredMissingInputs.evidence: Unique failed-input LFNs with actual [input-file] entries=N from producer preflight logs
measuredMissingInputs.caveat: These are measured TTree Entries, not proof every branch/event was readable and not accepted/pair statistics. Unmeasured failed inputs add nonnegative unknown counts. The 3413 processed count is a subset of its preflight Entries and is not added twice. Final normalization requires either the complete source snapshot or a successful completion log for every omitted nonfailed worker.

reportedEventWeights.caveat: These are saved/catalog/file-list reported weights, not measured failed-Pico Entries or accepted frames. Nonpositive advertised values are unknown placeholders. Incomplete weights do not yield an overall event-loss fraction.

assessmentLimit: File/job fractions alone do not establish negligible physics-statistics loss. Run concentration, actual missing accepted events/candidates and intended observables remain relevant.
